title: Lymphocytic Cicatricial Alopecias
subtitle: LPP vs FFA vs CCCA — distinguishing features

values.lpp: Perifollicular erythema, peripilar casts, Wickham striae
values.ffa: White dots, pinpoint white dots, lonely-hair sign, eyebrow loss
values.ccca: Hair tufting (2-3), peripilar grey/white halos, single hairs from ostia

values.ffa: Same as LPP + eyebrow follicle involvement
values.ccca: Premature desquamation of inner root sheath ★, perifollicular lamellar fibrosis
Moderate-strength topical steroid + minoxidil + counsel on traction/heat

values.ffa: Add finasteride/dutasteride; oral isotretinoin in refractory
values.ccca: Hydroxychloroquine, MMF; consider biopsy for atypical features
Centrifugal crown loss in F of African descent

citations.quote: Filbrandt R et al. Primary cicatricial alopecia: diagnosis and treatment. CMAJ. 2013;185(18):1579-1585.
